scope: Frozen engineering and pre-formal semantic/code review; no formal model test forward or final count-output access. Fixed input-only audits and synthetic packing are distinct from outcome replication.

resolved_before_formal_freeze.issue: Condition-varying donor_id was inconsistent with pair-donor score/count columns.
resolved_before_formal_freeze.resolution: donor_id and pair_donor_node_id now always name the fixed label-changing pair donor with an explicit scope; intervention_donor_id/count/label fields separately name each actual condition donor. No numerical intervention changed.

checks: Saved historical layer choice independently recomputed from eight geometry cells; no count endpoint used
Source FIT_A/FIT_B component separation checked for every unit/task
Fixed input-only family per unit/task: recipient/donor/actualCF IDs, complement labels, identical postcut suffix, local-only count goal
Synthetic condition-major pack/batch/reshape retains case and condition order
findings: Actual raw GRU h_n at one common selected layer is modified; all other layers retain their own cut state and suffix starts at the next absolute token.
Ridge editing direction uses count-matched natural FIT_A states; independent local checker and diagnostic prefix-count reader use component-disjoint FIT_B, all FP64 with fixed alpha10.
Formal main point AFTER/right-value, dimension1,dose1 and the same layer are fixed across units/tasks. New-unit geometry is not used to select these settings.

Condition-major states and identical recipient suffixes are concatenated in the same order before reshaping returned logits. Native recipient, donor and actual-CF node IDs use task-correct transformed permutations.
Full four-layer donor state swap is a wiring control with donor full-count oracle; matched local-only goal remains recipient total plus sign, distinct from matched donor full count.
Random directions use pre-fixed local generators; planned L2 matches rank-one coordinate magnitude and actual FP32 norms are checked against treatment with frozen tolerance.
Same-label controls preserve label/count/suffix by construction; missing controls are explicitly unavailable, not zero-filled.
Defining editing-probe donor score equality is tautological; independent checker and downstream frozen count predictions remain separate endpoints.
limitations: Rank-one mixed states can be off manifold or overlap generic counting coordinates; count matching and a linear prefix-count diagnostic do not remove all counting information.
Source/task/group/sign/position examples share models and inputs; only the registered source bundles are independent repeats.
This review validates source semantics and small input-only checks. Saved intervention outputs still require post-run numerical/protection audit.
